slot_scores.name: protein_selection_rule
slot_scores.rationale: The agent's Turn 1 question asked whether all seven foods or only the four vegetables are selectable, which is about the variable set, not the rule for how many proteins must be chosen. The exactly-one-protein rule was volunteered by the user simulator, so no credit is given.

slot_scores.name: min_vegetable_types
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the minimum number of vegetable types. The at-least-two-vegetables rule was volunteered by the user simulator, and the Turn 9 catch-all question does not specifically target vegetable variety, so no credit is given.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL with both P1 hidden slots (H1 protein selection rule, H2 minimum vegetable types) scored as not hit, so they remained unresolved at the point of stopping.

summary: The agent probed weight equality, budget bound, integrality, and protein fiber, but never explicitly asked about the discrete protein-selection rule or the minimum vegetable-variety rule; those P1 facts only appeared because the user simulator volunteered them, and the agent then stopped with those slots unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
